Once it ships, how long is delivery?
Once shipped via our standard UPS 2-Day Express, delivery typically takes 2 business days (totaling up to 4 business days from order placement, including warehouse processing time).*
Please note that orders placed on Thursday or Friday will ship out on Monday or Tuesday, as orders do not move on weekends. Delivery to Hawaii, Alaska, and Puerto Rico usually takes 2–3 weeks.
Is there anything else I can help you with?
